children: BRUSSELS (dpa-AFX) - Delivery Hero SE (DHER.DE), an online food ordering, quick commerce, and delivery services company, Thursday announced that it has agreed to its Co-founder and Chief Executive Officer, Niklas Ostberg, to continue in his role as the CEO of the company beyond March 31, 2027.

This intimation is contrary to the previous adhoc announcement made on May 12, and reflects the fundamentally changed situation of the company following the ongoing takeover offer and is based on Ostberg's current, existing service agreement which has a term until April 30, 2029.
Currently, shares of the company are trading at €36.79, up 0.03% on the Xetra Stock Exchange.
